title: Pro-rata manifest compiler
goal: Compute real per-holder distribution amounts from a finalized snapshot and a cycle's returned proceeds, with dust carryforward and >1024-holder chunking.
steps: Compute amount_i = floor(balance_i * proceeds / totalEligibleSupply) per holder from the finalized snapshot
Track the floor-rounding dust (proceeds - sum(amount_i)) and carry it forward into the next cycle's distributable pool per decision D6's default
Chunk holders into deterministic, address-sorted <=1024-entry groups when the snapshot exceeds 1024 non-zero balances, feeding WP-04's chunk-commitment path
Feed output unmodified into the existing deriveHolderDistributionCandidate in reconcile.mjs/manifest.mjs
